# Music Album-Folder Duplicate Report

**Status: report only — no music files were changed.**

- Library scanned: `/mnt/archive/Music`
- Indexed audio files examined: 229,075
- Same-folder duplicate groups: 2,631 in 488 album folders
- Overwrite canonical names with selected variants: 486
- Keep canonical names and remove other copies: 128
- Keep selected release-set filenames and remove differently named copies: 2,017
- Confidence: 877 high, 1,754 medium

## Selection rules

Duplicates are identified from Navidrome/ID3 metadata as files in the same album folder with the same normalized title, disc number, track number, and near-equal duration (within 3 seconds or 1.5%). The preferred copy is selected by (1) consistency with the surrounding release set—batch timestamp, album/artist/date/genre/codec tags, and common bitrate—then (2) audio quality, and (3) modification time. Recognized collision suffixes such as ` 1`, `(1)`, and `__dupe1` are removed only when the corresponding canonical filename exists.
